name: Intertwined Destinies
source:
Ash is a young girl haunted by her past.
Forced to live with an older brother who can't understand her, all she wants to do is finish high school as quickly as possible and run away.
Or at least that was her plan, until a strange book fell on her head!
When she opened it, she unleashed a strange, talking pink cat, along with many other far more dangerous creatures.
This pink cat from another dimension needs her help to get home: she must track down each of these creatures and lock them up in the cards they were sealed in, all in exchange for a wish.
Ready to do anything to right the wrongs of her past, Ash accepts this deal in order to go back in time.
Beside, it won't take too long or be that hard of task, right?
